note: Uncalibrated VLM preview; human scoring remains pending. Image delivery does not establish grading accuracy.

instruction.reason: Every stated requirement was observed: exact camera/ground/character geometry, route line at 0.03, walk/run speeds, fixed-step movement with arrival handling, leg phase animation, setWaypoint validation, JSON-safe state, save/load/import/reset, and all five wired controls. Only cosmetic label quirks remain.

interaction.reason: Play/Pause, Walk/Run, editable waypoints, Save, Load and Reset all behave reliably, give immediate telemetry/status feedback, reject invalid input visibly, and recover saved states across reset and reload.

spatial.reason: 3D shapes, proportions, shadows, ground scale and route geometry are coherent across three views and during motion; character faces and travels along route legs correctly.

stability.reason: No crashes or JS errors across repeated play/pause, patrol loops, invalid inputs, save/reset/load, reload and both viewport sizes; only a non-blocking favicon 404 and a deprecation warning.

visual.reason: Composition, typography and color are coherent and readable, but the in-scene waypoint labels are used inconsistently (multiple 'C' labels, generic glyph look) and duplicate the HTML overlay, which creates a small local identification defect.
